scope: All 24 released chromosome VCFs, not a sample; descriptive scan without inference or independent FASTA-span reconciliation.

definitions.score_unit: Published two-decimal delta score; histogram index is score multiplied by 100. Signed -0.00 is counted as zero.
definitions.variant_max: Maximum over all four score types and all gene annotations for one VCF record.
definitions.entry_max: Maximum over four score types for one variant–gene annotation.
definitions.distal: A reported score >0.00 with absolute associated delta position >50 nt (at most 500 nt).
definitions.distal_threshold: At least one individual distal event must meet the threshold; a proximal high score does not qualify a low distal score.
definitions.multigene: A VCF record with more than one distinct gene symbol; duplicate symbol entries fail the audit.
definitions.interpretation: Distal reported maxima are not a D50 rerun, a count of all affected splice sites, or an estimate of clinical sensitivity.
